value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate. It depends on the lender and on whether your down payment is under 20% (insured) or not. As of today, the lowest I can see is 4.34% for insured, and that's available in Ontario. Uninsured starts around 4.44%. The big banks are averaging about 5.14%, and rates have been creeping up this month.
